name: cli-agent-runner
description: Launch scoped Codex CLI workers with codex exec, capture stdout/stderr and final messages, and record normalized process-runner-result packets in .cli-agent-runner. Trigger on CLI Agent Runner, CLI subagent execution, or continuation of its workflow state. Primary route: explicit run/orchestrate --runner codex-cli. Non-use: generic coding and ordinary official-subagent work.

interface.shortDescription: Launch scoped Codex CLI workers and normalize their process results.
interface.longDescription: CLI Agent Runner is an explicit process-runner workflow for scoped Codex CLI workers. Its codex-cli route invokes codex exec, captures stdout/stderr plus the final message, enforces a machine-checkable repository scope, and records a process-runner-result packet under .cli-agent-runner. It does not replace generic coding or ordinary official-subagent routing, and this initial independent release supports only the codex-cli provider.
defaultPrompt: Use CLI Agent Runner to launch a scoped Codex CLI worker and return its process-runner-result.
Continue this .cli-agent-runner task with the next codex-cli assignment.
